findings.title: Positional-record properties now lose MsgPack005 silently
findings.argument: The new helper matches only `PropertyDeclarationSyntax`. For `record R([property: Key(null)] string X)` the declaration is a `ParameterSyntax`, so the location is null, and the new filter drops the diagnostic. The base file already handles `ParameterSyntax` elsewhere.
findings.fix_hint: Handle `ParameterSyntax` in the helper, as the base file already does; report instead of dropping when the member is in source.
